checked_contracts.result: External hash syntax and authority hash, strict shape, schema/state, opaque qualification/roles/row refs and principal metadata are checked before row reading and supervision decoding. Row bytes are pinned before decoding. Hash/structure is not semantic or training authority.
T/F predicates require Available and Known. U requires at least one missing bit. Known F dominates U, preserving every predicate; all-T is T; otherwise U is retained.

U candidates require null label/weight and false eligibility. Decided known candidates require explicit matching Boolean labels; unit weight only for eligible development_train. Ineligible known candidates have null weight.

An ambiguous parent withholds labels, weights and eligibility for every candidate. Conditional T/F/U predicates and candidate states remain inspectable; no false label is inferred from withheld values.

Value-copy arrays preserve active count5/8 plus8 stored slots; no retained mutable maps/slices or locks. Input contains request/candidate raw and normalized text plus framing count; IDs/source/group/role/states/masks/labels/weights are not projected.

Bounded row/authority bytes, exact mandatory decoded keys, duplicate/escaped-key/case aliases, pointer null distinction, integer spelling, UTF8 and unpaired surrogate rejection are visible in source. Candidate array exactly8, predicate cap64, active count5/8. No execution confirmation.
v1 permits1..8 explicit Boolean candidates with weight1 and no positive-cardinality guard. Zero and multiple positives are already representable; acquired corpus one-positive is not a Reader limit.

Every active candidate has Labels.Known=true whenever parent Truth!=Unknown; a mixed-known/U row cannot be directly represented without a revised projection/admission contract. The prototype supplies no Parent/Fit adapter.

limitations_and_controls.finding: A hash-valid authority with invalid ParentState or Cohort passes the initial principal checks and causes row reading/decoding before rejection. The existing mismatch-hash control proves rowRead0 only for that mismatch.
limitations_and_controls.prospective_action: If full invalid-authority shape must stop before row access, validate both enums before line142 and add one hash-valid malformed-authority counting-reader control. This is not observed unknown-to-false conversion or delegated admission.

limitations_and_controls.finding: verified0 excludes candidate-U AND predicate-U conservatively; verified1/many permit a knownF+U negative. verified_many has at least2 T and at least1 F. unknown_containing requires aggregate candidate-U, not merely predicate-U. These distinctions match the pinned coverage proposal, whose any-U zero policy still needs explicit Root adoption.

U also permits Available=false with Known=true because only both true is forbidden. No label is assigned. If Known implies Available in the future binding policy, that invariant must be separately frozen and rejected; no such extra invariant was assumed here.

Seven top-level synthetic functions cover six shape subcases, F+U retention, ambiguity/U null withholding, padding/availability, copied accessors/text invariance, authority hash failure before row read, and lexical/7/9 arity faults. They are not run or claimed PASS by this review.
limitations_and_controls.prospective_action: Direct unresolved boundaries worth controls are hash-valid invalid-authority enum, verified0 F+U rejection, validation-role eligibility, pointer false/null, and64/65 predicate boundary. Do not add shallow implementation-mirror tests.
